newsitem.title: UK: Rio Tinto gains on strong copper price.
newsitem.headline: Rio Tinto gains on strong copper price.

text.p: Shares in Rio Tinto Plc rose on Wednesday amid talk of analyst upgrades on the back of recent strength in copper prices, dealers said.
Rio -- formerly known as RTZ Corp Plc -- shares were up 6-1/2p at 10.73-1/2 by 0956, near their year's high of 10.90 stg set on May 23. In Australia the stock was up 34 cents at A$21.52 .

Dealers said a recent Bankers Trust report forecasting copper reaching $3,000 per tonne by year end had helped excite interest in Rio shares. Earlier on Wednesday copper hit a one-year peak of $2,550 per tonne.

"There has been some heavy interest in Rio in recent sessions," said one dealer, "the copper price has been firming and we are starting to see some earnings forecasts moving up. The stock is beginning to look rather cheap."
